cadfit_mesh.input: complete tessellated reference mesh, without BRep topology
cadfit_mesh.procedure: one residual refinement iteration, fillet/chamfer enabled; input-mesh IoU optimization
cadfit_mesh.limitation: Richer input and optimization budget than point/image neural models; report as mesh-fitting comparison.

dualbrep_pc.input: 32768 independently sampled oriented surface points; no face/edge labels
dualbrep_pc.procedure: point-cloud autoencoder, 256 cubed field resolution, 24 reconstruction rotations, 200 latent optimization steps
dualbrep_pc.limitation: Larger input and test-time optimization budget; released training pipeline unavailable.
